description: PLATEAU 4 terrain whose ReliefFeature gml:id also appears in a second file (the 08-dem common C01 input1.gml; input2.gml differs only in the dem:TINRelief gml:id, which the writer keeps like any other id, so it adds no case) read and written back: the one triangle is written as dem:tin > gml:TriangulatedSurface > gml:trianglePatches > gml:Triangle with no ids, and dem:lod comes before dem:tin. The duplicate across files is the quality-check actions' concern. New-world only: the legacy writer has no terrain support.
